protocol.description:
Sub-protocol for configuring NVIDIA QuadroSync (framelock) hardware through the Display Config Server. This protocol is advertised as a wl_registry global only when QuadroSync hardware is detected.
Warning: This protocol is unstable and subject to change without notice.

interface.name: zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_manager
interface.description: Global entry point for QuadroSync configuration. Advertised in wl_registry only when QuadroSync hardware is present.

request.name: get_output

description.summary: extend a DCS output with QuadroSync state

request.description: Creates a QuadroSync output object extending the provided DCS output.

request.name: get_topology

description.summary: extend a DCS topology with QuadroSync settings

request.description: Creates a QuadroSync topology object extending the provided DCS topology.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager object. Objects created through it are not affected and remain valid.

interface.name: zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_output
interface.description:
Extends zwp_dcs_output with QuadroSync state. Events are sent before zwp_dcs_output.done.
This object follows the zwp_dcs_output it extends: when that output's wl_output global is removed the server sends no further events here and the client should destroy this object as well. A role staged for a removed display on a zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_topology is reported at commit as unknown_output.

event.name: board

description.summary: QuadroSync board this display's GPU is attached to

event.description: Small integer identifying the board, stable for the lifetime of the server. Displays with the same id share one QuadroSync board. Not sent for a display whose GPU has no QuadroSync hardware.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object. The zwp_dcs_output it extends is not affected.

interface.name: zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_topology
interface.description:
Extends zwp_dcs_topology with QuadroSync state: per-display framelock roles and board-level settings. Everything staged here is applied by the base topology's commit. Setting a role twice for one output replaces the earlier value.
Framelock state follows the same rule as the base topology: a commit touches only the displays it names. A display's role persists until a later commit names that display with a different role, and a display that is not named keeps both its role and its current sync state. There is one framelock group per system; it is the set of displays whose role is server or client, across every commit made so far.
set_sync_enable applies to the displays named in the same commit. Enabling turns sync on for those displays (the server first), and disabling turns it off for them, while unnamed members of the group are left as they were. To engage or release the whole group, name every member. A commit that enables sync must name at least one display with a server or client role.
Role validation counts servers across the whole system: the roles staged in this commit plus the roles already configured on displays it does not name. A commit that would leave more than one server on this system is rejected with a null-output failed error, so building a group up over several commits cannot produce two servers.
Board-level settings (sync delay, polarity, house sync mode) are properties of the sync source. They are applied to the board of the display given the server role in the same commit. When the commit names no server, for example on a client-only system whose server is on another machine, they are ignored.

enum.name: error
enum.description: Codes sent with the error event. failed is only ever sent with a null output; the others name the problem with one display.

entry.name: failed
entry.summary: the QuadroSync part of the commit was rejected as a whole

entry.name: unknown_output
entry.summary: the wl_output is not a display managed by DCS

entry.name: invalid_role
entry.summary: the role is not a valid zwp_dcs_quadro_sync_output.role value

request.name: set_role

description.summary: stage the QuadroSync role for a display

request.description: Stages the framelock role for the given display: server, client, or disabled.

event.name: error
event.description: Reports a QuadroSync problem with the base topology's commit. With a non-null output it names one display and the reason its staged role was rejected. With a null output and the failed code it reports that the QuadroSync settings as a whole were rejected, for example because the role assignments cannot form a valid framelock chain. These events are sent before the base zwp_dcs_topology's terminating error event; this object never sends done.

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the display at fault, or null for the whole QuadroSync configuration

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object and discards its pending settings. The zwp_dcs_topology it extends is not affected; a later commit of that topology leaves the QuadroSync roles and board settings unchanged.
